**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Offline Chat
- **Ask it about WhisperShortcut.** The offline Chat now knows it runs inside WhisperShortcut, which model and version it is, and, once you ask about the app, its offline models, features and your keyboard shortcuts. Ordinary questions stay on the fast path.
- **You can see the download.** While an offline model downloads or loads, Chat shows its progress in place of the typing dots, and a progress ring next to the model menu in the message box. Your message is sent as soon as the model is ready. The floating download popup no longer appears in Chat.
- **Fixed a crash** when Chat tried to load a model whose download had been interrupted (for example Qwen3.5 9B). An incomplete download now counts as not downloaded and resumes.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.42...v8.43
